crossroads.kicker: Story Crossroads • Columbus Day Sibling Weekend, October 11, 2003
crossroads.title: Delores Grabs Leo's Arms: Does Luna Explode and Throw Her Out?
crossroads.prompt: This weekend was supposed to be just Leo, his twin sister Luna, and his older sister Stella—yet Delores hijacked the invite, shrieked at their printer, demanded Stella's legal guardianship, mocked Luna's Kaleidoscope Sun flute signal, and has just grabbed Leo's arms to yank him onto her lap. Both paths forward are complete, coequal stories (and shape Delores's upstream history in Jack & Sarah).

options.label: Luna Screams 'GET OUT!' & Reclaims the Sibling Weekend
options.subtitle: Luna erupts before Delores can touch Leo further, Stella backs her with full guardianship authority to throw Delores out for good, and the three siblings reclaim their weekend—skipping the four-day Pathfinder trip to Washington.

options.label: Bank Their Fury & Endure Through Tuesday
options.subtitle: Afraid of retaliation behind closed doors, Luna and Stella freeze, teach Leo the emergency TTY collect-call lifeline before Tuesday's bus, and fight across three thousand miles after the four-day Pathfinder trip to Washington.
